version.changelog: Skill Card 拆为独立文件 skill-card.md；线下邮寄改为盖章上传流程；填报信息中增加浏览器前提风险

llm.summary: This skill coherently generates Chinese software copyright registration documents from a user-selected codebase and only offers optional, user-confirmed browser assistance.

dimensions.detail: The scripts read a provided source directory or README and generate DOCX/Markdown registration materials, which directly matches the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The online filing workflow is optional, requires explicit user confirmation, uses a visible browser, and says not to submit automatically.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, package-install automation, or hidden setup behavior were found; metadata lists only the skill file and three helper scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may read substantial source code from a user-selected local directory and may clone a user-provided GitHub repository, which is expected for generating source-code registration materials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background workers, persistence mechanisms, credential storage, privilege escalation, or destructive file operations were identified; outputs are user-specified document files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that the skill reads your chosen source repository and can place portions of source code into generated registration documents. Use it only on code you intend to submit for copyright registration, review all generated files before upload, and keep control of any government-site login or final submission step.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact inspection was consistent with that clean result.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal showed zero malicious or suspicious engines, and no artifact evidence contradicted that signal.
[Static scan clean result] expected: The static scan reported no suspicious patterns; manual review found file reads and document writes aligned with the workflow.
